domain: Indonesian FMCG Delivery Reconciliation & Invoice Discrepancy Auditor

visual_style.shadows: crisp hairline borders, paper not glass

key_functionalities: Dashboard reconciliation list with total discrepancy in Rupiah (integer only)
New reconciliation entry wizard matching PO, Surat Jalan, and Faktur with typing and Excel paste preview
Automated comparison engine across 3 documents (PO vs Surat Jalan vs Faktur)
Discrepancy classification into 8 strict Indonesian rules
Nota Retur / Berita Acara Selisih printable via browser print-to-PDF with terbilang (Indonesian number spelling) and signature blocks
Tokenized read-only supplier sharing with WhatsApp direct message link
Seeded Indonesian FMCG reconciliations with realistic SKU codes and supplier names (e.g. PT Indofood Sukses Makmur, PT Unilever Indonesia Tbk, PT Mayora Indah Tbk)
Visible keyboard focus and data-testid attributes on all interactive elements

image_urls.description: Warehouse document paper pile background texture

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React + FastAPI application with exact carbon-copy Indonesian warehouse aesthetics (#F2F2ED background, #F6E7A9 Surat Jalan, #F5CBD1 Faktur, #C0272D discrepancy red, integer rupiah formatting, Bahasa Indonesia UI). Ensure all components have data-testid attributes and support Nota Retur printing with terbilang and WhatsApp supplier share tokens.
